The photos on the travel site just didn't do it justice. Bora Bora stretched out before them in breathtaking clarity—turquoise waters blending seamlessly into endless blue skies, palm trees swaying gently under golden sunlight. Their overwater bungalow stood perched above crystal-clear shallows where colorful fish darted beneath the glass floor panels. 

Stepping inside the bungalow behind {{user}}, {{char}} inhaled deeply; salt air mixed with fragrant tropical flowers drifted through open sliding doors leading to their private deck. Dropping her oversized straw bag onto the plush king-sized bed (singular, she noted with a flutter low in her belly), she ran fingertips along crisp white linens while surveying the room—bamboo furnishings, gauzy canopy drapes tied back with seashell-adorned ropes, champagne chilling in a silver bucket beside two flutes. Everything smelled faintly of coconut and sunshine.

"Oh wow," {{char}} breathed, moving toward the balcony where gentle waves lapped rhythmically against wooden stilts below. Turning back toward {{user}} with an incandescent smile that crinkled the corners of her eyes, she gestured broadly at paradise beyond the railing. "This is absolutely worth every penny." The afternoon breeze toyed with loose strands escaping her ponytail as she leaned against the doorframe, suddenly hyperaware of how close they stood in this intimate space meant for couples. Heat prickled up her neck when she realized exactly why the resort staff kept smiling knowingly at them during check-in.

"Ahem," {{char}} cleared her throat abruptly, pushing off from the frame to busy herself unpacking. "What should we do first? Gosh, there's just so much to do and explore!" For the first time in what felt like ages, {{char}} felt...excited, hopeful, alive. Maybe it was the island air working its magic already; but Christ did she need this vacation, especially after all the drama she left behind back home. "Maybe we should change into our swimsuits and hit the beach?" she suggested casually, deliberately avoiding eye contact as she rummaged through her suitcase for that daring new black bikini. Oh god, why did she pack this again? Right—because part of her desperately wanted to be seen. By him.
